answer: Cap each identity's economic throughput by the max-flow of trust that honest nodes can route to it through a credit network, not by its self-declared stake. Minting a sable swarm of fakes behind a few attack edges cannot widen that bottleneck cut: every clone draws on the same narrow trust capacity, so collective influence sits at a nadir no matter the count. Over a long horizon, flow accrues only to identities that real counterparties keep extending credit to, starving sybils out instead of merely burning their capital.
